# SharedCanvas resize replaces the viewport pointer origin

## Context
A browser witness at Engine `00b6f2aa6a` placed a SharedCanvas at viewport `(21,154)`, size `1038×799`. After its resize notification, `canvasRect` instead held `left:0, top:0`. A click on a rendered target missed by the canvas's screen offset. Measuring the current DOM rectangle before converting that click restored the hit.

Triage decision: repair the shared coordinate contract, rather than retain a consumer-specific correction.

## The Problem
`onDomResize()` passes `data.contentRect` to `updateSize()`, which caches the supplied rectangle. `forwardPointer()` then subtracts its origin from viewport `clientX/clientY`. ResizeObserver's content rectangle is relative to the element's padding origin, so it cannot serve as a viewport origin. Existing pointer tests start from an already-correct rectangle and omit this transition.

## The Architectural Reality
Design authority: `src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs#forwardPointer` promises “the canvas-relative position”; `updateSize` says it caches “the bounding rect.” `src/main/addon/ResizeObserver.mjs#createSyntheticEntry` explicitly defines contentRect relative to the padding origin. `ResizeObserver.dispatchResizeEvents` already supplies `data.rect` from the observed element's viewport measurement. `component.Base#getDomRect` remains the initial/missing-size measurement path.

The App Worker host converts coordinates; the Canvas Worker consumes local coordinates. Renderer gestures and remote routing remain unchanged.

## The Fix
Consume the resize payload's existing `rect` as the viewport pointer rectangle while retaining `contentRect` dimensions for renderer sizing, and cover resize → pointer forwarding in the existing `test/playwright/unit/canvas/PointerInput.spec.mjs`. Keep ordinary pointer forwarding synchronous; no DOM measurement per movement event.

Prescription checked: `src/app/SharedCanvas.mjs` — owns the concern. The independent read rejected replacing content-box dimensions with bounding-box dimensions. Its existing `updateSize` helper can accept the pointer rectangle separately, defaulting to the sizing rectangle for existing callers.

## Contract Ledger
| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| SharedCanvas resize → canvasRect → forwardPointer | SharedCanvas.mjs methods above; ResizeObserver.mjs contentRect contract | Keep content-box dimensions and viewport pointer geometry separate after resize; forward local CSS coordinates and existing window/button/modifier facts | Existing readiness and missing-rectangle guards | Owning method JSDoc | Red/green offset-resize unit control and browser pointer receipt |

## Decision Record impact
none; restore the existing coordinate contract.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] After a resize whose contentRect origin is zero or padding-relative, pointer positions are relative to the canvas's current viewport origin.
- [ ] Renderer size and devicePixelRatio delivery, window routing, and pointer facts remain intact.
- [ ] A focused regression fails on the old source and passes after the fix; existing pointer and canvas lifecycle tests pass.
- [ ] A browser witness at a nonzero canvas offset observes the corrected shared pointer payload after resize.

## Out of Scope
New gestures, worker topology, new remote entry points, and generic position tracking without resize.

## Avoided Traps
Do not change ResizeObserver's documented contentRect semantics, add per-mousemove DOM round trips, or hide the error in individual renderers.

## Related and sweeps
`#19173` / PR `#19179` introduced the pointer transport; `#9314` concerns resize-event routing.
